text: Core courses Management, Elementary Accounting, Outline of Economic Law, Marketing and Sales, Statistics, Monetary Banking, Consumer's Behavior, Financial Management, Advertising, Marketing Research, Strategic Management, Management Information System, and Sale Management Objective This objective is to train students to be middle-and-high-ranking specialized personnel who will be able to synthetically use professional marketing knowledge to analyze, plan, design or manage marketing activities to be carried out by enterprises and institutions of various types. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Management is granted.
